ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed towards low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 95% of the surface area, with extreme high-intensity (white) clusters localized at the distal lateral tips and along the splashing water line.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-grey to black pixels across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white clusters localized at the left and right trailing edge tips (coordinates approx. far left and far right extrema).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute-angled U-shaped depression at the central symmetry axis; depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke vertical height visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire continuous trailing edge; visible pixel amplitude varies between minor indentations and sharp peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips, exhibiting a slight upward 'flick' at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively on the trailing edge tips and outer lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-grey linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally on the upper regions of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both fluke lobes, creating a jagged, encrusted appearance distinct from the natural skin texture.
